dialogues.speaker: Sinchi's Message
dialogues.text: "If you need anything brought back, feel free to leave a message below. As long as it's within my abilities, I'll find a way to bring it back."

dialogues.speaker: Childish Handwriting
dialogues.text: "You wouldn't be able to bring back some meat for me, would you, Sinchi? I want to make some food for my sick little Saurian!"

dialogues.speaker: Sinchi's Message
dialogues.text: "No problem, I'll bring it back for you tomorrow."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Me too! Bring back some for me too!"

dialogues.speaker: Sinchi's Message
dialogues.text: "Hey now, it's not like Cacahuatl grows on trees, you know. Just reach down underground and dig some up for yourself!"
